citation: Sri Lanka Facts. Census Atlas 2024 private preview (v2026.11.4-preview.1).

indicators.definition: Number of households whose principal cooking fuel is firewood, as recorded by the Census of Population and Housing. Component of households_cooking_firewood_share.
indicators.name: Households using firewood as main cooking fuel (count)

indicators.definition: Share of occupied housing units whose principal cooking fuel is firewood, as recorded by the Census of Population and Housing.
indicators.name: Households using firewood as main cooking fuel

indicators.definition: Number of households enumerated by the Census of Population and Housing in the area.
indicators.name: Total households

indicators.definition: Number of occupied housing units enumerated by the Census of Population and Housing. A housing unit is a separate unit with independent walls; one housing unit may contain more than one household. This is not the same as the number of households.
indicators.name: Occupied housing units

indicators.definition: Mean number of persons per occupied housing unit, computed as total population ÷ occupied housing units. This is not the mean household size: one housing unit can contain more than one household, and the 2024 census reports 6,111,315 households against 6,030,541 occupied housing units nationally.
indicators.name: Persons per occupied housing unit

indicators.definition: Number of persons aged 0 to 14 years enumerated by the Census of Population and Housing.
indicators.name: Population aged 0–14

indicators.definition: Share of the population aged 0 to 14 years, computed as 100 × population aged 0–14 ÷ total population.
indicators.name: Share of population aged 0–14

indicators.definition: Number of persons aged 15 to 59 years enumerated by the Census of Population and Housing.
indicators.name: Population aged 15–59

indicators.definition: Number of persons aged 60 to 64 years enumerated by the Census of Population and Housing.
indicators.name: Population aged 60–64

indicators.definition: Number of persons aged 60 years and over, computed as the sum of the 60–64 and 65-and-over age groups in the Census of Population and Housing 2024 GN workbook.
indicators.name: Population aged 60 and over

indicators.definition: Share of the population aged 60 years and over, computed as 100 × population aged 60+ ÷ total population.
indicators.name: Share of population aged 60 and over

indicators.definition: Number of persons aged 65 years and over enumerated by the Census of Population and Housing.
indicators.name: Population aged 65 and over

indicators.definition: Total population divided by the land area of the unit in square kilometres. Area is computed from the COD-AB v03 boundary in EPSG:5235 (SLD99), not from the census table. Density is shown for context, not as a census count.
indicators.name: Population density

indicators.definition: Number of persons enumerated as female by the Census of Population and Housing in the area.
indicators.name: Female population

indicators.definition: Number of persons enumerated as male by the Census of Population and Housing in the area.
indicators.name: Male population

indicators.definition: Number of persons enumerated by the Census of Population and Housing in the area.
indicators.name: Total population

indicators.definition: Number of males per 100 females, computed as 100 × male population ÷ female population. A value below 100 means more females than males.
indicators.name: Sex ratio
